propositions: When completion verifier fails on evidence search exhaustion without refuting criteria, the gate should auto-resume with the same command instead of surfacing failure to the operator

Auto-resume qualification reuses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate without schema or prompt changes, triggering only when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker

Resumption loop sits at the shared close-gate seam in close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping llm.verify_completion, so CLI, MCP, and library closes all flow through the same single resumption logic

Auto-resume is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2, disableable to 0) and constrained by strict progress: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count
Each resumption attempt is logged with attempt number, cache-credited criteria count, and remaining unmet count, visible in ticket trail and close output
